scope: One prespecified paired feature ablation on repeatedly used development data. Replace only mating_acceptance with exact same saved-state predicate called without EC prerequisite. No app/model changes, engine queries, new labels, full fit, model selection procedure, tuning or sweep.
control: 150 columns in identical order (75 feature values plus75 missing indicators); only mating_acceptance value replaced in both windows. No missingness, eligibility, confidence, physical gates, row selection or weight changes. Both window scores minimized per case.

learners.custom: Original Tree AST;64 trees, max depth6, >=8 distinct moves per leaf, mtry=isqrt(150)=12; whole-group bootstrap; raw weighted leaf probabilities; negative split cost5; exact original seed streams

standard_rf.sample_weight: Same per-move initial equal total eligible-window weight; unweighted classes

primary: custom_corrected versus custom_retuned: more true positives without extra false positives on pooled outer OOF; report negative outcome equally. Corrected custom fixed5/6 is secondary control.
secondary: standard_rf_corrected versus standard_rf; no pooled outer-label cutoff selection or winner selection.

folds.mapping: Sorted unique groups by(sha256(salt+colon+group),group), index modulo fold count

threshold_selection: Each arm chooses cutoff independently using only inner OOF labels. Reference is original custom at5/6. Maximize true positives subject BOTH to FPcount<=reference FPcount and wrong fraction<=reference wrong fraction (cross product). Exact unique observed min-window scores; keep ties together. Tie: fewerFP, then higher cutoff. Empty awards if no feasible nonempty point. No outer labels used. Fixed corrected control uses5/6.
verification: All group/alias/canonical-position integrity assertions; no train/test group overlap. Unchanged149columns and all missingness exact. Original custom and RF outer scores match saved standard-learners <=1e-12 on all3724 cases, original custom_fixed/custom_retuned/RF awards exact; finite scores. Inputs, extractor artifacts and evaluator hash verified before first fit.
reporting: All3724 outer OOF scores+awards, five fold inner cutoffs and metrics, pooled and fold metrics, gained/lost correct/wrong keys, eligibleEC true/false strata, original429 eligible positive misses from originalcustom_retuned, feature flip counts. EC/miss breakdowns are descriptive and selected on same outer labels, not independent validation.

uncertainty.method: Paired whole-group bootstrap conditional on fixed outer OOF predictions
uncertainty.caveat: Excludes refitting uncertainty and repeated-research selection bias
